title: Sage skeleton_map record
description: A skeleton_map record (SkeletonMapRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another skeleton_map record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

source.description: The skinned model (.glb) whose clips are played: the clip library's rig. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

target.description: The skinned model (.glb) that plays them. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

bones.description: Target joint name -> the source joint it follows (as the models name them) (Dictionary<string, string>)

scale.description: Root translation scale; 0 = the ratio of the two rigs' hip heights at rest. At least 0. (float, default 0)

sampleRate.description: Keys a second the retargeted clip is baked at. Unit: Hz. Range: 1 to 240. (float, default 30)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
